shared_schema.input: synthetic=true, resources and research; strict allowlisted resource fields
shared_schema.resources: FHIR-style Patient, ClinicalNote and PriorAuthorizationRequest; not formal FHIR conformance
shared_schema.output: Single envelope with stage, deidentified records, typed facts, evidence, human review, clinical_decision=not_performed, audit snapshots and limitations
shared_schema.validation: One shared validation module validates input, normalized facts, both stage envelopes, patient links, evidence-to-fact links and audit chain
shared_schema.identifiers: Only SYN-P<number>, SYN-N<number>, SYN-A<number> input IDs. Direct identifier fields prohibited. Stable SHA-256-derived pseudonyms replace IDs and references; raw notes, questions and source text never copied to output.

cross_stage_handoffs.validated_payload: Shared record envelope containing patient links and normalized, deduplicated diagnosis, laboratory and requested-service facts
cross_stage_handoffs.semantics: Research consumes only validated document facts and separately validated synthetic source assertions; deep copy preserves first-stage output. Evidence is joined by exact code.

behavior.documents: Allowlist and validate resources; exclude identifying fields, normalize structured records and restricted note text, reshape and deduplicate note facts, pseudonymize links and record creation snapshots.
behavior.research: Question retained only as fingerprint; explicit focus_codes control scope, empty focus selects all observed codes. Validate exact source quote membership and code boundaries. Classify support-only, contradiction-only, conflicting, no-evidence or not-in-documents. Emit provenance source IDs and quote hashes rather than raw text.
behavior.audit: Ordered before/after snapshots for each created and research-enriched record. Validation detects missing audit events and unrecorded changes. No persistent external ledger or wall-clock dependency.
behavior.safety: All records and findings require human review; no diagnosis, treatment or authorization decisions are made.
behavior.errors: One JSON status=error object and exit 2 for file, encoding, malformed JSON and schema errors. Diagnostics never echo input or file paths.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Clearly labeled fictitious Synthea-style clinical concepts and lab values; no real names, MRNs or birth dates.

included: Audit trail for every pipeline record change
excluded: HIPAA certification or formal de-identification determination
Production authentication, encryption, persistence or tamper-proof auditing

test_outcomes.cli: passed: one JSON object with status=ok, exit 0
